items.text: Houston: DNP - RB David Montgomery (groin), S Reed Blankenship (concussion/hand); limited - LB Azeez Al-Shaair (groin), TE Brevin Jordan, OT Braden Smith (ankle). OT Blake Fisher and S Jalen Pitre full. C.J. Stroud starts.

Los Angeles Chargers: DNP - CB Deane Leonard (concussion), WR Brenen Thompson (quad/hamstring), S Kendall Williamson (calf), DE Khalil Mack (rest); limited - TE David Njoku, CBs Donte Jackson and Rodney Shelley, LB Denzel Perryman. On IR: S Derwin James Jr., OT Rashawn Slater, C Tyler Biadasz.
